================================================================================
1. PLATFORM OVERVIEW & DUAL-TRACK STRATEGY
================================================================================
AgentFinOps (powered by the core agent-core-sdk / AgentPay engine) is an enterprise-grade AI agent gateway, financial firewall, and FinOps governance platform.

Enterprise Positioning:
- Enterprise FinOps Track: AI Agent Gateway & FinOps Financial Firewall
  * Targets government/enterprise clients, SaaS developers, production AI agents.
  * Solves runaway loops, unmanageable departmental costs, lack of audit trails.
  * Payment channel: RMB virtual ledger (6-decimal micro-units), corporate bank transfer, WeChat Pay, Alipay, fully compliant without financial license requirements.

Fundamental Moat:
Underlying settlement rails are swappable infrastructure. AgentPay's core moat is the Financial Firewall, Non-Hanging State Machine (Hold/Capture/Release), and Immutable Audit Blackbox positioned between AI reasoning and external resources.

================================================================================
2. MASTER ROADMAP V2.0.0 SUMMARY
================================================================================
Priority Matrix:
- P0 (Near-term Master Line):
  1. Enterprise HITL Approval (Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk interactive cards)
  2. Legal Currency Prepaid & Anti-Two-Clearing Closed-Loop (6-decimal micro-units)
  3. Multi-tier Tree Quota Governance (Tenant -> Department -> Project -> Agent)
  4. MCP Native Payment Middleware (Server pricing + Client firewall)
  5. Langfuse Co-existence Trace Linkage Panel
- P1 (Important Evolution):
  1. Streaming Micro-Metering & Batch Settlement Buffer (millisecond token settlement)
  2. Java / Spring Boot Starter SDK (@AgentPayGuard)
  3. Node.js / Express / Fastify / NestJS Seller Middleware
- P2 (Architectural Hardening):
  1. Cloud KMS (AWS / Aliyun / Tencent) & Hardware HSM Signature Support
  2. Out-of-Process Sidecar Daemon (N6 threat mitigation via IPC/UDS)
  3. Distributed Gateway Cluster & Five-Way Reconciliation Scheduler
- P3 (Long-term Ecosystem):
  1. Enterprise On-Premise Suite (Docker Compose / Helm packaging)
  2. Industry Standard Proposal for Enterprise AI Behavior Auditing & Firewall.

================================================================================
3. ARCHITECTURE & CORE TOPOLOGY
================================================================================
Principles:
1. Zero-Trust on AI: AI proposes transactions; cryptographic signatures and payment commits execute strictly behind deterministic firewall policies.
2. Decoupled Lifecycles: PaymentIntent (business intent), Settlement (fund transfer), and Fulfillment (upstream resource delivery) are strictly orthogonal.
3. Multi-Tier Tree Hierarchy:
   Tenant (Org) -> Department (BU) -> Project -> Agent
   Cascade Invariant formula:
     Agent.spent_24h + delta <= Agent.daily_budget_cap
     AND Project.spent_month + delta <= Project.monthly_budget_cap
     AND Department.spent_month + delta <= Department.monthly_budget_cap
     AND Tenant.available_balance >= delta

================================================================================
4. SECURITY & THREAT MODEL (N1-N6)
================================================================================
Threat Vectors & Defenses:
- N1: Buyer / Gateway Key Compromise
  Defense: Cloud KMS / HSM Hardware security, zero plaintext keys in memory.
- N2: Replay of Expired / Consumed Authorizations
  Defense: Nonce tracking, valid_before / valid_after timestamps, idempotency tables.
- N3: Runaway Loop and Uncontrolled Spending Attack
  Defense: Local and gateway-level sliding window RPM circuit breaker, switches to OPEN in O(1) time.
- N4: Upstream API Timeout with Fund Hanging
  Defense: Non-hanging 3-state state machine: Hold -> Capture -> Release. On timeout, automatic Release restores balance atomically.
- N5: Runaway Agent Recursive Loop
  Defense: Local circuit breaker RPM sliding window. Switches to OPEN in O(1) time.
- N6: In-Process Memory Hijacking / Host Penetration
  Defense: Out-of-process Sidecar daemon running as low-privilege OS user via IPC.

================================================================================
5. PAYMENT STATE MACHINE (HOLD / CAPTURE / RELEASE)
================================================================================
Lifecycle States:
1. HOLD: Atomically reserve estimated quota (available_cache -= delta, held_cache += delta).
2. UPSTREAM CALL: Forward prompt/tool call to upstream model or paid API.
3. CAPTURE: On success with actual cost, deduct held quota permanently and record append-only ledger entry.
4. RELEASE: Atomically return remaining quota (delta - actual_cost) back to available_cache.
5. EXPIRY / ERROR: If upstream fails, status transitions to 'released', 100% of delta is unlocked.

================================================================================
6. INTERNAL VIRTUAL LEDGER & LEGAL CURRENCY PRECISION
================================================================================
- Currency Base Unit: 6 decimal places (1 CNY = 1,000,000 base units).
- Conversion rule from WeChat / Alipay (Cent / Minor unit):
    amount_base_units = payment_minor_amount * 10,000
- Floating-point prohibition: All ledger, arithmetic, and database columns MUST use 64-bit integer (BIGINT).
- Anti-Two-Clearing Compliance:
  Phase 1: Computing power / API prepaid voucher model (Zero license risk).
  Phase 2: Licensed institution split-clearing (WeChat Merchant / Alipay Direct Pay).

================================================================================
7. HITL APPROVAL & 402 ASYNCHRONOUS SUSPEND
================================================================================
Three-tier risk gradient:
1. Small (amount <= hitl_threshold): Millisecond automatic pass.
2. Medium (hitl_threshold < amount <= max_tx_cap): Gateway returns HTTP 402 with approval_id. Asynchronously pushes rich card to Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk.
3. Excessive (amount > max_tx_cap): Gateway blocks request immediately (SINGLE_TX_CAP_EXCEEDED).
Client SDK Behavior:
- Catches 402 with approval_id, pauses execution gracefully, polls status or awaits webhook.
- Upon mobile approval, SDK replays request with 'X-AgentPay-Approval-Id: <id>' and receives 200 OK.

================================================================================
8. MCP (MODEL CONTEXT PROTOCOL) INTEGRATION
================================================================================
MCP Server:
- Injects 'metadata.agentpay.price_base_units' into tools/list response.
MCP Client:
- Wraps callTool with local AgentPay Firewall.
- Pre-checks transaction budget, daily quota, and rate limits locally before dispatching tool calls.

================================================================================
9. LANGFUSE CO-EXISTENCE
================================================================================
- Langfuse manages Prompt, Token tracing, and LLM evaluation (The Brain).
- AgentPay manages Financial firewall, tool interception, and money settlement (The Hands).
- Pass-through: SDK injects 'X-Langfuse-Trace-Id' and 'X-Langfuse-Span-Id' into HTTP headers.
- Gateway stores trace_id in ap_request_record.
- AgentFinOps Console provides 1-click jump to Langfuse trace details.

================================================================================
10. CLIENT SDK QUICKSTART
================================================================================
Python:
```python
from agentpay_core import AgentPayClient, PolicyConfig, SQLitePolicyEngine

policy = SQLitePolicyEngine.create_in_memory(
    PolicyConfig(
        id="finance_agent",
        max_per_tx_base_units=5000000,          # 5.00 CNY
        rolling_budget_24h_base_units=50000000, # 50.00 CNY
        whitelist_domains={"gate.aipmedia.cn"},
    )
)

client = AgentPayClient(
    api_key="apk_live_xxx",
    gateway_url="https://gate.aipmedia.cn",
    policy=policy,
)

response = client.post("/api/v1/chat/completions", json={"model": "deepseek-chat", ...})
print(response.json())
```

TypeScript:
```typescript
import { AgentPayClient, PolicyConfig, SQLitePolicyEngine } from "agentpay-core-sdk";

const policy = SQLitePolicyEngine.createInMemory(
  new PolicyConfig({
    id: "finance_agent",
    maxPerTxBaseUnits: 5000000n,
    rollingBudget24hBaseUnits: 50000000n,
    whitelistDomains: ["gate.aipmedia.cn"],
  })
);

const client = new AgentPayClient({
  apiKey: process.env.AGENT_API_KEY!,
  gatewayUrl: "https://gate.aipmedia.cn",
  policy,
});

const response = await client.post("/api/v1/chat/completions", {
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: "deepseek-chat", ... }),
});
console.log(await response.json());
```

================================================================================
11. PROTOCOL ERROR CODES REFERENCE
================================================================================
- INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Available balance below required amount.
- SINGLE_TX_CAP_EXCEEDED: Requested amount exceeds single transaction cap.
- ROLLING_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: 24h rolling budget cap exceeded.
- QUOTA_EXCEEDED_DEPARTMENT: Department monthly quota limit reached.
- QUOTA_EXCEEDED_PROJECT: Project monthly quota limit reached.
- CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED: RPM limit exceeded; circuit open to prevent runaway loop.
- APPROVAL_REQUIRED: HTTP 402 with approval_id pending human approval.
- APPROVAL_REJECTED: Approver rejected the transaction.
- APPROVAL_EXPIRED: Approval request timed out.
- NONCE_ALREADY_USED: Cryptographic replay prevention triggered.
- DOMAIN_NOT_WHITELISTED: Target upstream domain not permitted by policy.
